$comment: Village memories and traditions (docs/proposals/phase-15-memories.md, src/sim/memories.js). A memory's source is decided in code by its id (powers: the god powers that cause it); mood while held; days held; stack: at most this many of the kind. A tradition comes from `count` memories of kind `from` over the village's history; its effects: mood, code (law leanings), petitionDays (a multiplier), halve (a memory kind whose mood counts half).

tradition.name: Hunters' pride
tradition.about: They have twice beaten the monsters of the wild.

tradition.name: Frugal
tradition.about: They have known famine twice and ration even in good times.

tradition.name: Devout
tradition.about: The gods have answered them twice; they wait patiently on their prayers.

tradition.name: Hardened
tradition.about: They have endured the gods' wrath twice and bear it more easily.
